hooks.command: REPO=/Users/huey/Projects/concert-crawl; WORKTREE=$(jq -r '.worktree_path'); cd "$WORKTREE" && pnpm i && find "$REPO" -name '.env.local' -not -path '*/.worktrees/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | while read -r src; do rel="${src#$REPO/}"; dest="$WORKTREE/$rel"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"; cp "$src" "$dest"; done
